items.title: Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, 1997
items.q: The trombone section were Frank Rosolino, Bob Burgess, he got Lee Konitz, saxophone, Zoot Sims. That’s the ‘53 band, the one we toured Europe with

ctx.x: How did you like playing with Kenton as opposed to Woody Herman?

Well I’ve got to preface what I say here. The first time I joined Kenton was in 1948 and it was the Eager Beaver Band. I wasn’t really crazy about that band. I liked Woody’s band better when I was with the band earlier, it was more of a swinging type band. But, as I stayed with the band, ‘48 was okay, then I went back in ‘50 or ‘51.
